definitions.explanation: A comment or action that indirectly criticizes or mocks someone without naming them directly. The speaker implies criticism through a seemingly general statement that the target (and often the audience) can recognize as aimed at them.

examples.english: Is that a snide remark directed at me?

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{当|あ}てこすり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧だ。
examples.english: She's good at making snide remarks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦{文句|もんく}→文句：03636_monku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}わ→言う：00515_iu⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{当|あ}てこすり⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{信用|しんよう}できない→信用する：25371_shinyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I can't trust someone who only makes insinuations instead of speaking directly.

notes:
{当|あ}てこすり is derived from the verb {当|あ}てこする (to make a snide remark). The noun form is more commonly used.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {当|あ}てこすり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ — to make a snide remark
- {当|あ}てこすり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧ — to be the target of insinuation
- ～⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{当|あ}てこすり — an insinuation aimed at ~

The key feature of {当|あ}てこすり is its indirectness — the speaker maintains plausible deniability while the intended target understands the criticism. This differs from ⟦{皮肉|ひにく}→皮肉：00103_hiniku⟧ (irony/sarcasm), which may be more openly cutting.
